statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service is necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The service directly addresses the documented clinical presentation requiring continuous ambulatory cardiac monitoring
